entities.summary: Robert Fidelis McKenna was an American Catholic Traditionalist Catholic bishop and priest of the Dominican order who was excommunicated from the Catholic Church. He was known for his traditionalist Catholic positions and was an advocate of sedeprivationism. McKenna was one of the leaders of the Orthodox Roman Catholic Movement (ORCM). He was also known from the Fox TV-movie The Haunted, which is about the Smurl haunting where McKenna conducted two exorcisms.
